name: io.github.MakkCH/minecraft-mcp
description: Control a Minecraft client with the Minecraft MCP mod and JsMacros Reloaded.

environmentVariables.name: MINECRAFT_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Token shown in the Minecraft MCP mod settings (F8).

environmentVariables.name: MINECRAFT_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port shown in the Minecraft MCP mod settings.

environmentVariables.name: MINECRAFT_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP(S) game bridge base URL, including a proxy path prefix. Overrides MINECRAFT_MCP_PORT. The MCP process stays on the agent computer.
